title: Cat Grooming Carry Bag Adjustable Neck Circumference Breathable Foldable Portable Pet Bathing Bag For Nail Trimming
body_html: 1、[Adjustable] The neck circumference of the pet grooming carry bag can be adjusted to meet the needs of different size pets and prevent them from breaking free. 2、[Limbs Openings] Cat grooming bag is designed with separate openings for the limbs, so you can take out a separate foot as needed to prevent your pet from scratching. 3、[Breathable] Pet grooming carrier bag is designed with a wide range of mesh cloth, which is breathable and comfortable to ensure that your pet will not feel stuffy in the bag. 4、[Waterproof Lining] This cat grooming tote bag has a waterproof lining, easy to clean, rinse directly with water or wipe with a wet wipe or wet rag, convenient and time saving. 5、[Easy To Use] Portable small pet grooming bag with multiple hook and loop and zipper closure, easy to put on and take off, single person can also easily complete the operation.Item Type: Cat Grooming Carry BagMaterial: Mesh Cloth, Canvas1 x Cat Grooming Carry Bag
